title: Text → Pixel Art (Z-Image Turbo)
description: RD Fast equivalent: style presets, exact art size, palette size, transparent background.

title: Image → Pixel Art (convert + AI redraw)
description: Any picture to pixel art: a direct algorithmic conversion and a Z-Image img2img redraw (strength).

title: Reference Images → Pixel Art (FLUX.2 klein)
description: RD Plus / PixelLab style-reference equivalent: subject + style reference images and a text prompt.

title: Edit Pixel Art (text + image references, FLUX.2 klein)
description: Instruction edits on an existing sprite; optional second image as an extra reference.

title: Inpaint Pixel Art (region edit, FLUX.2 klein)
description: Change only a rectangle (or painted area) of a sprite; everything else stays pixel-identical.

title: Rotate Sprite → 4/8 Directions (FLUX.2 klein)
description: PixelLab-style rotations: one edit per facing; west-facing views are mirrored for perfect symmetry.

title: Rotate Sprite HQ (Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 + Multiple-Angles LoRA)
description: 96-camera-pose LoRA for the most consistent turnarounds. Slower (20B, GGUF Q4).

title: Object → 4 Views 2×2 Sheet (klein base + sprite-sheet LoRA)
description: fal's 2x2 sprite-sheet LoRA: isometric left/right, side and top-down views of an object in one pass.

title: 4-Direction Walk Spritesheet from Text (klein base + LoRA)
description: 32×32 character sheet: walk down/left/right/up, arms raised, jumps, lying down — plus a GIF per direction.

title: 4-Direction Walk Spritesheet from a Reference (klein base + LoRA)
description: Same as 09 but from an image of your character (concept art, a sprite, a photo).

title: Animate Sprite – any action or free text (Wan 2.2 14B I2V)
description: RD Animation / PixelLab text animation: 36 presets (combat, movement, creatures, props, FX) or free text.

title: Animate Sprite – seamless loop (Wan 2.2 14B first = last frame)
description: First and last video frame are your sprite: perfect loops and 'returns to the starting pose' motions.

title: Seamless Tile / Texture (Z-Image + circular tiling)
description: RD Tile 'single tile' equivalent: perfectly wrapping pixel textures at any tile size.

title: Autotile Tileset – wang16 + blob47 (Z-Image + seamless + SpriteKiln)
description: RD Tile 'tileset' equivalent: two seamless terrains combined into dual-grid and 47-blob autotile sets.

title: Pixelize / Unfake + Palette Swap (no AI)
description: Fix 'fake' AI pixel art (auto grid detection), reduce colours, recolour to retro palettes, add outlines.

title: Spritesheet → GIF / APNG / Aseprite JSON (no AI)
description: Slice any sheet, stabilise, export animation files for engines.

title: 8-Direction Animated Spritesheet (klein rotations + Wan 2.2 14B)
description: PixelLab-style: one sprite -> 8 facings -> the same action animated in every facing -> one row per direction.

title: Keyframe In-betweening (Wan 2.2 14B first → last frame)
description: Animate between two poses you control (e.g. stand → crouch, wind-up → slash end). Chain clips for combos.

title: Equipment Layer for an Animation (paper-doll / swappable gear)
description: Re-dress every frame of a base animation with a weapon/armour reference and extract it as a transparent layer that lines up with the base sheet frame-for-frame.

title: Text → Animation / VFX (no sprite needed)
description: Describe a character, creature, prop or effect and its motion: Z-Image draws frame 1, Wan 2.2 animates it.

title: Animated Seamless Tile (water, lava, grass…)
description: RD animated tiles: a seamless pixel tile animated with Wan 2.2 while staying tileable in every frame.

title: Colour Ramps, Palette Swap, Hue Shift, Scale2x (no AI)
description: Hue-shifted ramps, enemy/team colour variants, recolours and pixel-art upscaling.

title: HD 2D Art from Text (painted / cartoon, no pixels)
description: Rayman-style painted cartoon characters, creatures, props, icons and VFX as clean transparent PNGs.

title: HD 2D Edit with Text + Image References (FLUX.2 klein)
description: Change outfits, props, colours or poses of HD 2D art; optional second reference image.

title: HD 2D Rotate → 4/8 Directions (FLUX.2 klein)
description: Turnarounds of painted / cartoon characters with mirrored west views and a shared-size sheet.

title: HD 2D Animate – presets or free text (Wan 2.2 14B)
description: Painted / cartoon character animation from one image: 35 actions or your own sentence, HD sheet + GIF/APNG.

title: HD Seamless Texture + Parallax Background Layer
description: Painted tileable textures (both axes) and horizontally looping parallax backgrounds.

title: Character → Rig Parts for Cutout Animation (SAM3 + klein inpainting)
description: Split a character into named parts (head, torso, arms, legs, weapon…), inpaint the hidden sections, export aligned layers + JSON for Spine / DragonBones / Godot Skeleton2D.

title: Sprite Normal Maps for 2D Lighting (pixel or HD, no AI)
description: Normal + height maps so engine lights shade sprites like HD-2D games; works on single sprites and whole sheets.

title: HD Normal Maps with AI Shape (MoGe + sprite inflation)
description: For painted / HD art: MoGe reads real 3D shape (faces, folds, armour) and is blended with silhouette rounding.
